brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — discrepancy 13 days old. Luke signed; microbial results, batch-record conflicts and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, actual shipments, microbial results and batch records with Sam today; record authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Get existing COAs into Evelyn’s hands. Luke/Roon QC is blocked. The four FSS COA filenames already in Aidan’s November 19 inbox match Ron’s requested lots; Evelyn’s receipt and QA acceptance are unverified. Request is one day old, with no fixed deadline stated. Send internally: Evelyn and Ron, use the four FSS COAs in Heather’s November 19 email and the existing Lotioncrafter documents today; confirm Evelyn’s receipt and match contents to physical lots before QA disposition—do not request duplicates.

ACT NOW 3: Roon — five days to requested December 1 run. Complaint disposition and approved R7 test timing remain unverified. A new full-week dispensing test today cannot finish before December 1; requested production is not PLL-approved. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, review affected lots and complaints with Sam today, verify the actual approved R7 test start and full-week test plan, and reconcile QC and operational holds before any December 1 commitment.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk’s lot disposition first, then deliver matched existing COAs to QC and settle Roon’s test-versus-run decision.
Scheduled: One tentative event within 72 hours; nearest today at 10:00 AM Eastern—confirm attendance. CRM: 20 active tasks, 13 overdue, five future-dated, two undated; none dated due within 48 hours.
